data.source_title: Predictors of Psychiatric Boarding in the Emergency Department
data.locator: Methods and Results; Table 1. Boarding defined as ED stay >4 hours after medical clearance among patients requiring inpatient psychiatric treatment.
data.source_setting: Retrospective cohort at two community EDs in Illinois; patients requiring inpatient psychiatric treatment and transfer to regional facilities.
data.source_n: 671 included encounters: private insurance n=120, Medicare/Medicaid n=312, self-pay/uninsured n=239.
data.unit: percent within insurance category boarding >4 hours after medical clearance
data.source_evidence_basis: Retrospective encounter cohort; table gives boarding counts of 94/120 privately insured, 224/312 Medicare/Medicaid, and 228/239 self-pay. Overall 546/671 boarded.
data.limitations: Two Illinois EDs, historical data and a study-specific >4-hour definition. Association is not causal; insurance category may proxy multiple placement constraints. Do not transfer these percentages as current or local rates.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Use as evidence that psychiatric placement access can vary with payer/funding pathway; represent payer authorization and destination availability as potential parallel blockers, then replace with local data.

data.source_title: Predictors of Psychiatric Boarding in the Emergency Department
data.locator: Results and Discussion. Mean ED length of stay compared by destination funding type among patients transferred for inpatient psychiatric care.
data.source_setting: Same two Illinois community EDs; patients transferred to public or private psychiatric facilities.
data.source_n: 671 total cohort; subgroup denominators for public vs private destination comparison were not reported in the cited Results passage.
data.quantity: Mean ED length of stay by receiving psychiatric facility funding type
data.source_evidence_basis: The paper reports mean ED stay of 1,661 minutes for patients transferred to publicly funded facilities versus 705 minutes for those transferred to private facilities (p<0.001). This endpoint is total ED length of stay, not a separately isolated placement-search interval.
data.limitations: Subgroup denominators unavailable in the cited passage; retrospective and limited to two EDs in 2010-2012. Total ED stay includes care before placement search and cannot be interpreted as placement wait alone.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Keep ED clinical evaluation and post-disposition placement search as separate states; treat destination funding type as a candidate context factor for scenario sensitivity, not a causal multiplier.
